facts.headline: Thousands flee as First Nations bear the brunt of Canada’s wildfires
keywords: thousands flee nations bear brunt canada
facts.seoTerm: thousands flee nations bear brunt canada
facts.summary: The Namaygoosisagagun (Collins) First Nation, located about 125 miles north of Thunder Bay and inaccessible by road, was largely destroyed by wildfire in under an hour on Wednesday. Community members went door-to-door to warn their neighbors, and more than two dozen people fled by boat with minutes to spare before the flames overtook their homes.
